clue.text: Rat keeping tense and upright

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it within, so one word is placed around the others

parts.note: to rat on someone is to inform, which in slang is to sing
T is the grammar abbreviation for tense
taken as written

explanation.surface: A rodent stays rigidly upright while under stress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rat' looks like the animal but is the verb meaning to betray, as an informer who sings to the police does.
explanation.definitionFit: Something upright is erect on its feet, a synonym in the sense of a person not sitting.

clue.text: Wine editor's fired

parts.note: sack is an old word for sherry or similar white wine
ED is the abbreviation for editor, the 's being the verb is

explanation.surface: The wine editor has lost his job.
explanation.definitionFit: To be dismissed from a job is to be fired, a synonym in the employment sense.

clue.text: Answer sage prepared lacking good understanding

indicators.note: food prepared is worked over, so the letters are reworked
lacking says a letter is missing from the rearranged pool

explanation.surface: A wise man readied a reply that showed little real comprehension.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of ANSWER SAGE, less G (good), are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Awareness is knowledge or perception of a situation, a synonym of understanding.

clue.text: I sign under 500 books

indicators.note: in a down clue the later pieces sit below the Roman numeral

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500
Aries is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Someone signs for a batch of five hundred books.
explanation.definitionFit: Diaries are books in which daily events or appointments are recorded.

clue.text: Observes absence of publication for teachers?

parts.note: no means none, an absence of something
TES is the Times Educational Supplement, a British weekly for teachers

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that there is no magazine for schoolteachers.
explanation.definitionFit: To note something is to observe or take notice of it, a synonym in the third person.

clue.text: Gave a smack to child, entertaining sister, oddly

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to hold them inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a kid is a child

indicators.note: oddly picks the first, third and fifth letters of the word sister

explanation.surface: Someone slaps a child who is looking after a sibling, in a strange way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smack' suggests a slap, but here it is a smacking kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack can be a loud kiss, so giving one is kissing someone.

clue.text: Minute, hot insect under stone

indicators.note: in a down clue the insect sits below the stone

parts.note: in, as in popular or fashionable, means hot
ST is the abbreviation for stone, a British unit of weight
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: A small, hot insect lies beneath a rock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Minute' looks like the adjective meaning tiny; it is the noun, a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: An instant and a minute are both a very short time, synonyms as in wait a minute.

clue.text: Almost foolish to wrap king's gift

indicators.note: wrapping a present means putting something around it, so the shortened word goes round
almost means nearly all, so the last letter of the synonym goes

parts.note: silly means foolish
K is the abbreviation for king in chess

explanation.surface: It is nearly silly to wrap a present for the king.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift can mean a natural talent or ability, a synonym of expertise.

clue.text: Daughter is sitting on plant — catastrophe!

indicators.note: in a down clue the first pieces sit above the plant

parts.note: an aster is a daisy-like flowering plant

explanation.surface: A girl crushes a flower by sitting on it, disaster.
explanation.definitionFit: A catastrophe is a terrible calamity, a synonym.

clue.text: College dance is on 4th of June, head of department guaranteed

parts.note: a prom is a formal college dance

indicators.note: the fourth letter of the word June
the head of a word is its first letter, here of department

explanation.surface: A student dance is set for 4 June, as the head of department promised.
explanation.definitionFit: To guarantee something is to vow or pledge it, a synonym.

clue.text: Unfortunately scratchier cat is making marks

indicators.note: things gone unfortunately have gone wrong, so the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A cat that scratches more is regrettably leaving marks on things.
explanation.definitionFit: Distinguishing marks are the traits or features that identify someone, a synonym in the sense of qualities.

clue.text: English soldiers retreated — that is beginning to suggest foes

indicators.note: a retreating army goes back the way it came, so the word for soldiers is read backwards

parts.note: men is a common word for soldiers, as in officers and men
i.e. is the Latin abbreviation id est, meaning that is

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter, here of suggest

explanation.surface: English troops fell back, which hints at the presence of an opposing army.
explanation.definitionFit: Foes and enemies are synonyms for those who oppose you.

clue.text: Complaint from this writer as the French succeeded

parts.note: the setter speaking of themselves is me
taken as written
le is French for the, masculine singular
S is the abbreviation for succeeded in family trees

explanation.surface: A writer's grievance comes from imitating French success.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Complaint' reads as a grievance; it means an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: A complaint can be an illness or ailment, and this is a childhood disease with a rash.

clue.text: Tinker gets old emails?

parts.note: to tinker with something is to mess with it
to get old is to age, and he ages

explanation.surface: A tinkering repairman grows old, perhaps while dealing with his emails.
explanation.definitionFit: Emails are an example of electronic communications, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Motions get users worried

indicators.note: worried means agitated and shaken up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Proposals at a meeting make the users anxious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Motions' suggests formal proposals at a meeting; it means movements of the hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Gestures are movements of the body to express meaning, a sense of motions.

clue.text: Peter Sellers keeps to the point

indicators.note: the actor's name keeps the letters held within it, across the two words

explanation.surface: The comic actor Peter Sellers remains concise.
explanation.definitionFit: Speech that is to the point is brief and curt, a synonym in the sense of concise.

clue.text: Flexible versatile folk

indicators.note: something flexible bends into other shapes, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: People described as flexible and adaptable.
explanation.definitionFit: Your folks are your family members, kin related by blood or marriage.

clue.text: Where one might find holidaymakers bearing drinks

parts.note: one's air is one's bearing or manner
port is a fortified wine, so ports are drinks

explanation.surface: Holidaymakers might be found carrying drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: Holidaymakers flying abroad are found at terminals where planes take off.

clue.text: Problem children

definitions.meaning: a matter of concern or difficulty

explanation.surface: Children can be a problem.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a matter in dispute and, in legal language, a person's offspring.

clue.text: European allowed to hug blokes for a bit

indicators.note: hugging someone wraps arms around them, so one word goes around the other

parts.note: let means allowed
men are blokes, a British informal word for men

explanation.surface: A European is allowed to embrace men briefly.
explanation.definitionFit: An element is a small part or trace, as in an element of truth.

clue.text: Lady's nude dancing — all's initially removed in two shakes

indicators.note: dancing letters move about, so the words are rearranged
removed says a letter is taken out of the rearranged pool
initially picks the first letter of the word all's

explanation.surface: A naked lady dances and everything comes off in an instant.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of LADYS NUDE, less A (the first letter of 'all's'), are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: In two shakes is an idiom for very quickly, without warning.

clue.text: Former lover refers to tickles

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
to cite is to refer to, quote

explanation.surface: An old flame mentions tickles.
explanation.definitionFit: To tickle someone's fancy is to arouse or stir them, a synonym in the sense of thrill.

clue.text: Conservative fails to win contracts

parts.note: to lose is to fail to win

explanation.surface: A Tory politician does not secure contracts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contracts' looks like a noun; it is the verb meaning narrows or shuts.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that contracts shrinks or narrows, as a gap does when it shuts.

clue.text: Raised plain coat and a uniform

parts.note: to plate metal is to coat it, as with silver
U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A plain, simple raised coat goes with a uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: A tableland is an elevated, flat expanse of land, which is what a raised plain describes.

clue.text: A very soft, large, eastern fruit

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical notation for very soft

explanation.surface: A very soft, big fruit from the east.
explanation.definitionFit: A pippin or Granny Smith is a common fruit of the orchard.

clue.text: Concert — almost remember about it

indicators.note: about means around, so the shortened word goes around the other
almost means nearly all, so the last letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: to recall is to remember

explanation.surface: At a concert, someone nearly remembers something about it.
explanation.definitionFit: A recital is a musical performance by a soloist or small group, a type of concert.

clue.text: Relation's allowance cut

indicators.note: something cut is shortened, so the last letter of the synonym is removed

parts.note: a ration is a fixed allowance of food

explanation.surface: A relative's allowance has been reduced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relation' looks like a relative; it is the mathematical relation between two quantities.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratio is a quantitative relationship between two amounts, as in three to one.

clue.text: Stripteaser even excited congressmen?

indicators.note: excited things are stirred up, so the letters are mixed into another order

explanation.surface: A stripper got even politicians worked up.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the US House are called representatives, an example of congressmen, hence the query.

clue.text: Son caught hospital department's smells

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
ENT is the ear, nose and throat department, with 's added

explanation.surface: A boy catches the odours of the ear, nose and throat ward.
explanation.definitionFit: Smells and scents are synonyms, odours detected by the nose.

clue.text: Fists cutting head after prisoner's lies

indicators.note: after places the shortened word after the prisoner

parts.note: a con is a convict, with 's added

indicators.note: cutting the head removes the first letter of the word fists

explanation.surface: A convict tells lies with his fists while headbutting someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that lies in a thing is contained in it; the verb is used in the same sense, as in happiness lies in health.
